guidance.summary: Expanding Q Tech camera module capacity to 180-190 million units annually
guidance.speaker: Atul Lall
guidance.quote: We are expanding the capacities of camera module in subsidiary Q Tech, which is an ECMS beneficiary for smartphones from 70 million annually to 180 million to 190 million annually over the next 15 to 18 months, largely catering to a captive smartphone volumes in addition to deepening the level of manufacturing.

guidance.summary: Expecting 20% to 25% QoQ smartphone volume growth in Q2
guidance.speaker: Saurabh Gupta
guidance.quote: So quarter 2 against quarter 1, we are expecting a 20%, 25% kind of a growth.

guidance.summary: Expecting FY27 smartphone volume close to 32 to 33 million units excluding Vivo
guidance.speaker: Atul Lall
guidance.quote: Our last year numbers were around 32 million, 33 million. We feel we should be somewhere close to that number.

guidance.summary: Mobile export revenue addition of INR 18,000 to 20,000 crore in a couple of years
guidance.speaker: Atul Lall
guidance.quote: We feel that in a couple of years, that can add almost 15 million to 20 million to our numbers, additional quantity in a couple of years. So which is an addition of almost INR18,000 crores to INR20,000 crores of revenue.

guidance.summary: Expanding refrigerator capacity to 3.2-odd million by Q4 FY27
guidance.speaker: Atul Lall
guidance.quote: The new product categories of frost -free 240 and 280 liters, deep freezers and mini coolers is going to be launched by Q4 of the current fiscal, expanding the capacity from 1.5 million to 3.2-odd million, which is going to be the largest capacity of refrigerators at a single site.

guidance.summary: Telecom segment revenue expected between INR 6,700 and 7,000 crore in FY27
guidance.speaker: Atul Lall
guidance.quote: So, telecom revenues, please appreciate, we have grown from INR700 crores to INR 3,600 crores to INR5,000 crores and we feel, as I mentioned earlier, we're going to be somewhere between INR6,700 crores to INR7,000 crores in this fiscal.
